name: Oni

actions.name: Iron Kanabo
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone and stunned until end of their next turn.

actions.name: Cone of Cold
actions.effect: A blast of freezing energy in a 12m cone. PHYS save for half.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.effect: Creates an area of magical darkness in a 6m radius that lasts 1 minute. Even darkvision cannot see through it.

reactions.name: Regeneration
reactions.effect: At the end of any turn where the Oni took damage, it regenerates 5 HP. This does not function if the Oni took fire or radiant damage that turn.

reactions.name: Vengeful Strike
reactions.effect: When a creature within reach hits the Oni, it can make an Iron Kanabo attack against the attacker.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can assume the form of any Small or Medium humanoid, or revert to its true form. Its statistics remain the same regardless of form.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The Oni can turn invisible at will (ends when it attacks or casts). Can fly at normal speed.

lore: Oni are fearsome ogre-demons of Japanese mythology, known for their brutal strength and cunning intellect. They disguise themselves as humans to infiltrate communities, indulging in cruel deceptions before revealing their true monstrous form to wreak havoc.
